theater: 中越邊境高平—諒山—河口戰線

battle.name: 中越戰爭
battle.theater: 中越邊境高平—諒山—河口戰線
battle.brief: 一九七九年二月十七日，解放軍以約二十萬兵力自廣西與雲南越境，攻入越南北部，高平、諒山與友誼關一線成主戰場，三月十六日全軍撤回。全役以步兵、炮兵與邊防民兵為主，海軍奉命不參戰，北部灣沿岸僅有巡邏艇與岸防炮兵零星交火；一八六二年式鐵甲艦早已退役，只在導彈快艇與海軍戰史課裡續命。

kit.name: 鐵甲艦
kit.history: 木殼外面包了鐵。裝甲第一次比砲更難對付，砲塔的設計從此繞著它轉。

countries: 交戰的兩方是中國與越南兩個社會主義國家，卻已在邊境打了十幾年的槍。中國一方是人民解放軍，部隊按兩個作戰方向編組：東面廣西方向由廣州軍區前指駐南寧統一指揮，序列內有第43軍第121、122、123師，第41軍第160、161、162師，第50軍與第55軍所屬第149、164、58師，另有炮兵第1師、獨立坦克團、公安邊防部隊與廣西民兵；西面雲南方向由昆明軍區前指駐開遠指揮，投入第11軍、41軍、50軍及所屬第31、37、38、39、40、42、149師，配第4炮兵師與獨立坦克團，空運與後勤由自湖北方向進場的第13空運師支援。越南一方是人民軍：第1軍區第3、338、346師死守高平、諒山、老街一線，第4、第7、第316、327、337、345、326師由南方向北調動，第2軍團自柬埔寨回援，邊防民兵與公安武裝頂在最前沿。蘇聯不是交戰方，卻以空運、大批裝備與軍事顧問介入，成為越南一方的實質後盾。
countriesEn: The two sides were China and Vietnam, two socialist states that had nonetheless been shooting at each other along the border for more than a decade. On the Chinese side stood the People's Liberation Army, organised around two axes of operations. The eastern axis, in Guangxi, was run by the Guangzhou Military Region front headquarters at Nanning; its order of battle included the 43rd Army's 121st, 122nd and 123rd Divisions, the 41st Army's 160th, 161st and 162nd Divisions, the 149th, 164th and 58th Divisions of the 50th and 55th Corps, together with the 1st Artillery Division, an independent tank regiment, Public Security border troops and Guangxi militia. The western axis, in Yunnan, was commanded from the Kunming Military Region front headquarters at Kaiyuan, drawing on the 11th Army, the 41st and 50th Corps and their 31st, 37th, 38th, 39th, 40th, 42nd and 149th Divisions, supported by the 4th Artillery Division and an independent tank regiment, while the 13th Air Transport Division, coming in from Hubei, supplied the airlift and logistics. On the Vietnamese side stood the People's Army of Vietnam: the 1st Military Region's 3rd, 338th and 346th Divisions held the line at Cao Bang, Lang Son and Lao Cai; the 4th, 7th, 316th, 327th, 337th, 345th and 326th Divisions were pulled northward from the south; the 2nd Corps was recalled from Cambodia; and the border militia and public security armed forces bore the burden of the front line. The Soviet Union was not a belligerent, yet its airlift, its mass deliveries of equipment and its thousands of military advisers made it the effective sponsor of the Vietnamese side.
people: 真正拍板的是鄧小平。一九七八年七月中共政治局已討論對越動武，九月解放軍總參謀部形成共識；鄧小平一九七九年二月八日回國，二月九日作出決策，二月十一日向廣西、雲南兩軍區下令二月十七日開戰，二月十五日宣布終止一九五〇年中蘇友好同盟互助條約，並公開宣告進行自衛反擊。前指層面，廣西方向由許世友任指揮員、張仲華任政委、周德禮任參謀長；雲南方向由楊得志任指揮員、劉志堅任政委、孫幹清任參謀長。作戰準備由解放軍副總參謀長張愛萍主持，他在內部研判中堅持速戰速決，認為一旦拖成消耗戰，蘇聯介入便會改寫全局；事後北京以「有限戰爭、不與蘇聯直接對抗」作為對莫斯科的交代。越南方面由黨中央政治局、國務院與國防部主導，國防部長兼總參謀長文進勇主持全國作戰部署，范文同主持國務院，主張北越必須放棄對柬埔寨的軍事介入；一九七八年十二月二十五日越軍攻陷金邊、赤色高棉政權覆亡，成為中方開戰的表面理由。
peopleEn: The final decision was Deng Xiaoping's. The Politburo of the Chinese Communist Party had already discussed military action against Vietnam in July 1978, and the PLA General Staff reached a consensus in September. Deng returned to China on 8 February 1979 and made the decision on 9 February; on 11 February he ordered the Guangxi and Yunnan military commands to open the offensive on 17 February, and on 15 February China announced the termination of the 1950 Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship, Alliance and Mutual Assistance while publicly declaring the self-defensive counterattack. At front headquarters level the Guangxi axis was led by Xu Shiyou as commander, Xiang Zhonghua as political commissar and Zhou Deli as chief of staff; the Yunnan axis by Yang Dezhi as commander, Liu Zhijian as political commissar and Sun Ganqing as chief of staff. The operational preparations were directed by Deputy Chief of the General Staff Zhang Aiping, who held firm within the command that the war had to be decided quickly, on the reasoning that once it degenerated into an attritional slog, Soviet involvement would rewrite the situation; afterwards Beijing accounted for the campaign to Moscow as a limited war that would never pit the two allies directly against each other. On the Vietnamese side the Politburo, the Council of Ministers and the Ministry of Defence directed the war, with Minister of Defence and Chief of the General Staff Van Tien Dung running the national operational plan, and Pham Van Dong heading the Council of Ministers on the line that North Vietnam had to give up its military involvement in Cambodia. The fall of Phnom Penh to Vietnamese troops on 25 December 1978, which ended the rule of the Khmer Rouge, supplied the ostensible reason for the Chinese attack.
kits: 這場戰爭的兵器主體是步兵的輕武器與火炮，而卡面這件一八六二年英國鐵甲艦在本役既沒有、也不可能出現在戰場：木殼包鐵的裝甲艦在十九世紀末已被全重裝甲的戰列艦取代，一九七九年的海上主力已是導彈護衛艦與武裝快艇。首日開火後，中國海軍南海艦隊曾以水面艦艇的艦炮射擊海防與海南島沿岸的岸上目標，越方岸防炮兵隨即還擊，雙方都有艦艇受傷的說法，但沒有任何一方戰艦被確認擊沉；北京為免與蘇聯正面相撞，下令海軍不參戰，海軍航空兵只在北部灣巡弋。真正決定戰局的是地面火力：解放軍以56式衝鋒槍為步兵主力，配63式122毫米牽引榴彈炮、59式130毫米加農炮、81式122毫米與90式122毫米多管火箭炮、40式反坦克火箭筒、59式與62式坦克、63式高射炮，後勤靠汽車縱隊、邊民擔架隊與空運維持，作戰車輛多為改裝或老舊型號；越軍以AK-47、RPG-7、PT-76與T-54、蘇制122與130毫米火炮、S-75防空導彈、MiG-19與MiG-21、Su-7與A-37迎戰，邊防民兵則大量裝備繳獲的美製卡賓槍與火箭筒。回望一八六二年，裝甲第一次讓砲彈難以貫通；而中華海軍自己的鐵甲艦定遠與鎮遠要到一八八〇年代才建成，甲午海戰的教訓至今仍列在海軍院校的戰史課上，二〇一七年下水的定遠複製艦把這段傳統重新做成能駛向海面的紀念艦。
kitsEn: The weapons of this war were, for the most part, infantry small arms and artillery, and the ironclad on the card face — an 1862 British design — could neither be nor was present on the battlefield. The wooden-hulled, iron-plated armoured ship had been superseded by the fully armoured capital ship before the end of the nineteenth century, and the naval fighting force of 1979 was already the missile frigate and the armed fast boat. After the first day's shooting, elements of the PLA Navy's South Sea Fleet fired their deck guns at shore targets around Haiphong and on Hainan Island, and Vietnamese coastal artillery returned the fire; both sides have claims of damaged ships, but no warship on either side was ever confirmed sunk. Beijing, unwilling to collide head-on with the Soviet Union, ordered the navy to stay out of the fighting, and naval aviation only patrolled the Gulf of Tonkin. What actually decided the battle was ground firepower. The PLA infantry was built around the Type 56 submachine gun, supported by 122mm Type 63 towed howitzers, 130mm Type 59 field guns, 122mm Type 81 and Type 90 multiple rocket launchers, Type 40 anti-tank rocket launchers, Type 59 and Type 62 tanks and Type 63 anti-aircraft guns; logistics rode on motor vehicle columns, stretcher teams drawn from the border population and airlift, and many of the vehicles in service were converted or obsolete types. The Vietnamese fought with AK-47 rifles, RPG-7 launchers, PT-76 and T-54 tanks, Soviet 122mm and 130mm guns, S-75 surface-to-air missile batteries, MiG-19 and MiG-21 fighters and Su-7 and A-37 attack aircraft, while the border militia were largely armed with captured American carbines and rocket launchers. Looking back to 1862, armour had for the first time made shot difficult to penetrate; and China's own ironclads, Dingyuan and Zhenyuan, were not built until the 1880s, the lessons of the First Sino-Japanese War remain on the naval academy curriculum, and the replica Dingyuan launched in 2017 turned that tradition once more into a commemorative ship that can sail on the open sea.
tactics: 這是一場以炮兵火力準備開路、步兵營連突擊、邊防民兵配合滲透的邊境戰。開戰前一夜，解放軍各方向以營為單位在夜色中渡過界河，先佔領邊境要點與制高點，再以炮兵群壓制越軍陣地，逐個村寨推進；每個步兵師均配屬炮兵營，攻堅時先以重迫擊炮與火箭炮覆蓋目標，再由突擊排沿田埂、溝渠與稻田接近，坦克團按連營配屬，逐級壓上。兵種分工上，公安邊防部隊與民兵封鎖缺口、押送俘獲裝備、維持交通線，公路沿線設有前進補給站。雲南方向在紅河與同登一線反覆拉鋸，廣西方向在友誼關正面突破後轉向諒山，先奪北側山頭再進逼城區，最終以逐屋爭奪攻入城內。反擊一方的越軍依托村寨、堤壘與野戰陣地，邊民兵打游擊，正規師在縱深組織反突擊，並自柬埔寨方向回調部隊堵缺口。撤退階段解放軍分批後撤，殿後部隊與炮兵擔任掩護，前線實行焦土處理與補給徵用，公路與鄉村設施被破壞。空軍只在邊境上空武裝巡邏，未與越機交戰；海上僅有北部灣的巡邏與岸炮零星還擊。
tacticsEn: This was a border war fought on a pattern of artillery preparation, battalion and company assault by the infantry, and infiltration by the border militia. On the night before the attack the PLA crossed the boundary in company strength in the dark, seized the key points and commanding heights along the frontier first, and only then brought artillery groups down on the Vietnamese positions, working village by village; every infantry division had an artillery battalion organic to it, and for assaults the heavy mortars and rocket launchers first saturated the target, after which assault platoons closed in along field paths, ditches and paddy fields, while the tank regiments were attached down to company and battalion level and pressed forward in echelon. Division of labour went as follows: public security border troops and the militia sealed gaps, escorted captured equipment and kept the lines of communication open, and forward supply depots were set up along the roads. In Yunnan the fighting saw repeated seesaw action on the Red River and Dong Dang lines; in Guangxi, after breaking through head-on at Friendship Pass, the troops turned toward Lang Son, took the heights north of the town before closing on the city, and finally fought their way in house by house. On the Vietnamese side the army fought from village fortifications, dikes and prepared field positions, the border militia conducted guerrilla action, the regular divisions mounted counterattacks in depth, and troops were recalled from Cambodia to plug the gaps. During the withdrawal the PLA pulled back in batches, with rear-guard units and artillery providing covering fire; scorched earth and requisition of supplies were applied along the front, and roads and village facilities were destroyed. The air force patrolled armed over the border zone only and never engaged Vietnamese aircraft; at sea there were patrols in the Gulf of Tonkin and scattered return fire from coastal guns.
data: 兵力上，邊境一線集結的解放軍部隊逾五十萬，實際越境作戰的兵力約二十萬，並投入二百輛59式、62式與63式坦克；越方公開資料稱北部約有六萬人，同時在河內方向留置約三十萬部隊，另有自柬埔寨與南部調來的十餘個師。蘇聯以空運向越南提供四百輛坦克與裝甲車、五百門迫擊炮與防空炮、五十門BM-21火箭炮、四百具便攜式防空導彈、八百枚反坦克導彈、二十架戰鬥機，並派駐五千至八千名軍事顧問。傷亡數字各方差距極大：中國軍方內部外洩的數字為陣亡六千九百五十四人，越方通訊社宣稱解放軍傷亡逾四萬四千人，另有來源給出六萬二千五百人的總數，並稱摧毀五百五十輛車輛與一百一十五門火炮；中方則估計越軍損失五萬七千人、民兵七萬人，吳學謙曾對法國軍事代表團稱越方傷亡五萬、中方兩萬。戰役自二月十七日開火到三月十六日全軍越過邊境撤回，歷時二十八天，解放軍作戰開支約三十四億五千萬元人民幣。進攻縱深多為十五至二十公里，部分方向深入至四十公里。
dataEn: On the numbers: more than half a million PLA troops were massed along the border, some two hundred thousand actually crossed into Vietnam, and two hundred Type 59, Type 62 and Type 63 tanks went in with them. Vietnamese public sources put about sixty thousand men in the north, while around three hundred thousand troops were held back in the Hanoi direction and a dozen-odd divisions were brought in from Cambodia and from the south. The Soviet Union airlifted to Vietnam four hundred tanks and armoured personnel carriers, five hundred mortars and anti-aircraft guns, fifty BM-21 rocket launchers, four hundred portable surface-to-air missiles, eight hundred anti-tank missiles and twenty jet fighters, and between five thousand and eight thousand Soviet military advisers were stationed in the country. The casualty figures differ enormously between the two sides: leaks from Chinese military sources give 6,954 dead, Vietnam's news agency claimed more than 44,000 PLA casualties, and other Vietnamese sources gave a total of 62,500, together with the destruction of 550 vehicles and 115 artillery pieces; on the other side, Chinese estimates put Vietnamese losses at 57,000 soldiers and 70,000 militia, and Wu Xiuquan told a French military delegation that Vietnam had lost 50,000 and China 20,000. The campaign ran from the opening of fire on 17 February to the last troops crossing the boundary home on 16 March, twenty-eight days in all, and the PLA's cost of operations was about 3.45 billion yuan. The advance was generally fifteen to twenty kilometres deep, reaching some forty kilometres on certain axes.
cause: 開戰理由分三層。最外層是柬埔寨：一九七八年十二月二十五日越軍攻陷金邊、推翻赤色高棉，越軍進駐柬埔寨並扶植新政府，中國視之為蘇聯勢力在東南亞的延伸，擔心雲南與廣西側翼受壓。中層是邊界本身：兩國邊界標線長期不清，爭議地點多達一百六十四處、面積二百二十七平方公里，兩國在哨所與田地之間互相越界耕種、驅趕，邊境衝突次數由一九七四年的一百二十五次升至一九七八年的二千一百七十五次；一九七八年八月友誼關事件中，越方武裝人員越境驅逐邊民並與中方執勤武裝對峙，其後在北京舉行的談判仍然破裂。最內層是國內與國際格局：越方的經濟改造政策引發大批邊民越境，邊境行政與軍事摩擦隨之升級，蘇聯在越南擴軍並把金蘭灣變成據點，中越之間長年的援助與顧問關係斷裂；中國則在文革之後重整國防，北面同時面對蘇越與美越兩個方向的壓力，又在美國建交、越南尚與美國交戰之際，判定國際條件允許一次「有限、可控」的懲罰性行動。
causeEn: The reasons for the war fall into three layers. The outermost was Cambodia: on 25 December 1978 Vietnamese forces captured Phnom Penh and overthrew the Khmer Rouge, then occupied the country and installed a new government; China read this as an extension of Soviet power into Southeast Asia and worried about pressure on its Yunnan and Guangxi flank. The middle layer was the boundary itself. The demarcation between the two states had long been unclear, with some 164 disputed locations covering 227 square kilometres, and the two sides repeatedly crossed the line to farm and to drive each other's people away; the number of frontier incidents rose from 125 in 1974 to 2,175 in 1978. In the August 1978 Friendship Pass incident, Vietnamese armed personnel crossed the border to drive out border dwellers and clashed with Chinese security troops on duty, and the talks held in Beijing afterwards still broke down. The innermost layer was the domestic and international situation: Vietnam's economic restructuring policies pushed large numbers of border dwellers across the line, administrative and military friction along the frontier escalated, the Soviet Union expanded its presence in Vietnam and turned Cam Ranh Bay into a base, and the long relationship of Chinese aid and advisers to Hanoi was severed. China, meanwhile, was reorganising its national defence after the Cultural Revolution, faced pressure on its northern flank from the Soviet-Vietnamese and American-Vietnamese directions at once, and judged — with the United States newly established in diplomatic relations and Vietnam still fighting the United States — that the international conditions permitted a limited, controllable punitive action.
impact: 這場戰爭在軍事上只有二十八天，在政治與戰略上卻拉長了十二年。中國用一次邊境戰摧毀了越軍在北部的前沿堡壘，迫使其把進攻柬埔寨的第2軍團調回北方防守，越北防衛壓力自此成為越方的長期負擔；但越軍並未退出柬埔寨，中國最主要的政治目標並未達成。戰爭把中美接近的節奏加快，也把蘇聯在東南亞的伸展推到前台，蘇聯無法直接出兵越南，只能空運與供應，這一極限在三年後的阿富汗問題上重演。對解放軍本身，裝備老舊、後勤吃緊與初戰受挫的記錄，促成鄧小平推動精兵簡政、恢復院校體系與大比武制度，一九八五年更進行百萬大裁軍。邊境戰火也未因一九七九年而結束：一九八四年四月的法卡山、牛皮山之戰延續數年，一九八八年三月的赤瓜礁海戰中，越南海軍與中國海軍在海上直接交火，成為一九七九年邊界爭端延伸至南海的一段。
impactEn: Militarily the war lasted twenty-eight days; politically and strategically its effects ran for twelve years. With a single border campaign China destroyed the forward works of the Vietnamese army in the north and forced Hanoi to pull the 2nd Corps out of its Cambodian offensive and back to the northern defence, so that the defence of the northern provinces became a permanent burden for Vietnam; but Vietnam did not leave Cambodia, and China's principal political aim went unmet. The war accelerated the rapprochement between Beijing and Washington and pushed Soviet expansion in Southeast Asia into the open: Moscow could not intervene directly against Vietnam and could only airlift and resupply, a limit that was to be demonstrated again three years later in Afghanistan. For the PLA itself, the record of obsolete equipment, strained logistics and a rough opening would push Deng Xiaoping towards a leaner force, a restored academy system and the revived military skills competitions, culminating in the million-man cut of 1985. Nor did the frontier fire go out after 1979: the fighting over Fakao Mountain and Niupi Mountain in April 1984 ran for years, and in the Battle of Johnson South Reef in March 1988 the Vietnamese and Chinese navies fought each other at sea, an extension of the 1979 border dispute into the South China Sea.
result: 結果是一個雙方都能宣告勝利的僵局。解放軍在二十八天內越境深入，打下高平、諒山、芒街等要點，重創越軍邊防與民兵，摧毀大批營房、永久工事與後勤設施，把前線推到距國境十餘公里處，隨後於三月十六日全部撤回中國境內，兌現了「有限戰爭、不在越南留駐」的自我約束；越南則在邊防民兵承受主要損失、正規主力基本完整的條件下頂住攻勢，於三月六日下令全國總動員，四月進入河內談判，保住了柬埔寨方向的既有部署。真正懸而未決的是邊界線本身：一九七九年的實際控制線經數年軍事與外交角力，直到一九九一年兩國關係正常化、一九九九年《中越陸地邊界條約》簽署才以條約形式確定，南沙群島的爭端則留到一九八八年才在海上見真章。撤退時大批繳獲的越軍槍砲、軍用物資與文件被帶回中國，成為雙方下一輪邊境角力的實物底帳；而中方在戰後重整了邊防與民兵體系，把前線推到距國境十數公里處，換來一九八〇年代沿線長達數年的低強度消耗戰。
resultEn: The result was a stalemate that both sides could declare a victory from. In twenty-eight days the PLA drove deep into Vietnam, took key points such as Cao Bang, Lang Son and Mong Cai, wrecked Vietnamese border troops and militia units, destroyed large numbers of barracks, permanent works and logistics installations, and pushed the front to within some ten kilometres of the frontier, before withdrawing entirely back into China on 16 March and honouring its self-imposed constraint of a limited war with no troops left in Vietnam. Vietnam, with the border militia absorbing the main losses and its regular forces largely intact, held off the offensive, ordered a general mobilisation of the entire country on 6 March and entered negotiations in Hanoi in April, preserving its existing deployment in the Cambodian direction. What remained genuinely unsettled was the boundary line itself: the line of actual control established in 1979 was settled only after years of military and diplomatic contest, and was fixed by treaty with the Sino-Vietnamese Land Boundary Treaty of 1999, following the normalisation of relations in 1991; the dispute over the Spratly Islands was not resolved on the sea until 1988. On the way out, large quantities of captured Vietnamese rifles, artillery, matériel and documents were carried back into China and became the physical ledger of the next round of frontier rivalry; and afterwards China reorganised its border defences and militia system, holding the line some ten or more kilometres inside its own territory, which bought a low-intensity war of attrition along the frontier through the whole of the 1980s.
